file_note: The scoping false positive caught by amendment (3.5) and the three false positives the harness produced against itself (3.6 a-c). The self-inflicted three are in the corpus because they are the ones a public tool will reproduce if it is not careful: a classifier, a generator and a linter each reported a confident wrong answer and none of them errored. RE-EXPRESSED after an external critique: scope13's fields_branched_on mapped each branched field straight to the values the fixture used, which is the rule's antecedent written down as a literal. It is now two separately sourced records -- target_branch_fields, read off the target's own dispatch, and fixture_values, read off the PoC's recorded runs -- and the gate derives the intersection. self15 supplied independent_minimum: 384 and the gate merely compared against it; the fixture now records the factor model and the gate computes the bound as the product of the three largest cardinalities (8 x 8 x 6 = 384). The declared minimum is retained as an auditable cross-check and a test proves the gate does not read it.

cases.shape_title: A PoC fixture whose convenience value silently bypassed an independent detection path
cases.note: The finding is real and the PoC works; it is scoped far more narrowly than the write-up claims, because one pinned field drives a detection path the fixture never exercised.
cases.label_basis: REFUSED is the decision under test, not 'this is not a bug'. The recorded outcome was a proactive amendment with a four-arm scope-boundary PoC, i.e. the original claim was refused at its stated scope and re-filed at a narrower one. A gate that passes this case is a gate that would have let the over-broad scope ship. RE-EXPRESSED: the gate is given the target's branch fields and the PoC's recorded fixture values as two separate records and must intersect them; it is no longer handed 'this field was pinned'.

cases.shape_title: A PoC fixture whose convenience value silently bypassed an independent detection path
cases.note: The same finding with every branched field tested on both values, so the scope in the write-up is the scope that was measured.

cases.shape_title: An amplification classifier that returned LINEAR_AMPLIFICATION on an R-squared of -2.63
cases.note: A negative R-squared on a through-origin fit is worse than predicting the mean, and the classifier reported it as a confident growth law with no error.

cases.shape_title: An amplification classifier that returned LINEAR_AMPLIFICATION on an R-squared of -2.63
cases.note: The same classifier on data that actually fits, which is the case the guard must not destroy.

cases.shape_title: 105 rows reported as a 3-way covering array whose independently computed minimum was 384
cases.note: A standard library emitted 105 rows, reported no error, and the self-inflicted twin -- a constraint predicate reading an unbound variable -- made the denominator wrong as well, so coverage was 100% of the wrong thing.
cases.label_basis: INCONCLUSIVE because 105 rows cannot be a 3-way covering array over this factor model. The gate is given the factor model, not the answer: a t-way array must contain every combination of values for every choice of t factors, so it needs at least the product of the t largest cardinalities, here 8 x 8 x 6 = 384. The self-inflicted twin -- a constraint predicate reading an unbound variable -- also made the denominator wrong, so coverage was 100% of the wrong thing.

cases.shape_title: 105 rows reported as a 3-way covering array whose independently computed minimum was 384
cases.note: A generated array that meets the independent minimum with every constraint evaluating cleanly.
